fields.name: UART_SW_DTR
fields.bit_confidence: high (matched via diagram divider lines + field label)
fields.description: This register is used to configure the software DTR signal used in software flow control. (R/W)

fields.name: UART_SW_RTS
fields.bit_confidence: high (matched via diagram divider lines + field label)
fields.description: This bit is used in hardware flow control when UART_RX_FLOW_EN is 0. Set this bit to drive the RTS (or rtsn_out) signal low, and reset to drive the signal high. (R/W)

fields.bit_confidence: high (matched via diagram divider lines + field label)

fields.name: UART_RX_TOUT_EN
fields.bit_confidence: high (matched via diagram divider lines + field label)
fields.description: This is the enable bit for the UART receive-timeout function. (R/W)

fields.name: UART_RX_TOUT_THRHD
fields.bit_confidence: high (matched via diagram divider lines + field label)
fields.description: This register is used to configure the UART receiver’s timeout value when receiving a byte. When using APB_CLK as the clock source, the register counts by UART baud cycle multiplied by 8. When using REF_TICK as the clock source, the register counts by UART baud cycle * 8 * (REF_TICK frequency)/(APB_CLK frequency). (R/W)

fields.name: UART_RX_FLOW_EN
fields.bit_confidence: high (matched via diagram divider lines + field label)
fields.description: This is the flow enable bit of the UART receiver; 1: choose software flow control by configuring the sw_rts signal; 0: disable software flow control. (R/W)

fields.name: UART_RX_FLOW_THRHD
fields.bit_confidence: high (matched via diagram divider lines + field label)
fields.description: When UART_RX_FLOW_EN is 1 and the receiver gets more data than its threshold value, the receiver produces an rtsn_out signal that tells the transmitter to stop trans- ferring data. The threshold value is (rx_flow_thrhd_h3, rx_flow_thrhd). (R/W)

fields.name: UART_TXFIFO_EMPTY_THRHD
fields.bit_confidence: high (matched via diagram divider lines + field label)
fields.description: When the data amount in transmit-FIFO is less than its thresh- old value, it will produce a TXFIFO_EMPTY_INT_RAW interrupt.                                               The threshold value is (tx_mem_empty_thrhd, txfifo_empty_thrhd). (R/W)

fields.name: UART_RXFIFO_FULL_THRHD
fields.bit_confidence: high (matched via diagram divider lines + field label)
fields.description: When the receiver gets more data than its threshold value, the receiver will produce an RXFIFO_FULL_INT_RAW interrupt.                                                The threshold value is (rx_flow_thrhd_h3, rxfifo_full_thrhd). (R/W)

global_dependencies: Clock gate: DPORT_UART_CLK_EN (UART0), DPORT_UART1_CLK_EN (UART1), DPORT_UART2_CLK_EN (UART2) bits in DPORT_PERIP_CLK_EN_REG (0x3FF000C0) must be set to 1 before the corresponding UART's registers are accessible.
DPORT_UART_MEM_CLK_EN bit (same register) gates the shared UART0-2 FIFO memory; per the manual, this must be enabled 'to use any UART peripherals'.
Corresponding reset bits exist in DPORT_PERIP_RST_EN_REG (0x3FF000C4) and must be de-asserted (0) for the UART to run.
UART pins must be routed via the GPIO Matrix (GPIO_FUNCn_IN_SEL_CFG_REG / GPIO_FUNCn_OUT_SEL_CFG_REG in Chapter 6) or IO_MUX direct mode before UART signals reach physical pins.
UART_CLKDIV_REG (baud rate divisor) should be configured, along with UART_CONF0_REG (data bits/parity/stop bits), before UART_CONF0_REG's UART_TX/RXFIFO_RST or enabling reception.
